title: Report: NFL will split four games from ESPN between YouTube and Netflix

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Report: NFL will split four games from ESPN between YouTube and Netflix
sources.description: As part of the deal that gave ESPN control over NFL Network and that gave the NFL 10 percent of ESPN, the league absorbed the four games that had been part of the now-abandoned Monday night doubleheaders.
